"Automated Test Required" column — automated tests are not required there; list
manual/smoke verification only.)*

### [Story Title] — [Type]

**What to test**:
- [Specific formula or rule from the PRD Formulas section]
- [Each named state transition or decision branch]

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Zero/minimum input values (e.g., 0 usage, empty record set / empty tenant)
- Maximum/boundary input values (e.g., max seats, rate limit ceiling)
- Invalid or null input (e.g., missing payload, unauthenticated session)

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for this sprint:

1. Application loads and renders dashboard/landing page without crash
2. User signup / authentication and workspace session can be started
3. [Primary workflow/feature introduced or changed this sprint]
4. [Any system with a regression risk from this sprint's changes]
5. Database CRUD operations and state persistence complete without data loss
6. Web performance is within budget (Core Web Vitals LCP < 2.5s, API p95 latency < 250ms)

*Smoke tests are verified by the developer via `/saas-smoke-check`. Reference this
list when running that skill.*

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true (at `qa.level: minimal`, drop
the test-file and smoke rows below — tests are waived there; the screenshot and
sign-off rows stay at every level, because the look is not):

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — via automated test result OR documented
      manual evidence (screenshot, video, or usability test notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories *(qa.level standard/full)*
- [ ] Retained screenshot of each screen touched, in `production/qa/evidence/`, for all Visual/Feel and UI stories *(every qa.level)*
- [ ] Signed-off evidence doc at `production/qa/evidence/[story-slug]-evidence.md` for all Visual/Feel stories *(every qa.level)*
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/saas-smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off) *(qa.level standard/full)*
- [ ] No regressions introduced
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/saas-code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/saas-story-done`)

**Stories requiring usability test sign-off before close**: [list, or "None"]
